Name: PLAYER_CAMOUFLAGE_PATTERN_PARAM_ST
Description:
Defines the Pattern options for Armored Cores.

Row ID links the Preset to the icon texture in SB_Camouflage.dds and SB_Camouflage.layout

Row ID + 210701 links the Preset to the FMG name it uses in the menu.

Fields.Name: Pattern Scale: Small Part
Fields.Description: The UV scale to use with the pattern texture when applied to 'Small' parts.

Fields.Name: Pattern Scale: Medium Part
Fields.Description: The UV scale to use with the pattern texture when applied to 'Medium' parts.

Fields.Name: Pattern Scale: Large Part
Fields.Description: The UV scale to use with the pattern texture when applied to 'Large' parts.

Fields.Name: Slot 0 Enabled
Fields.Description: If ON, colour slot 0 of the pattern can be recoloured.

Fields.Name: Slot 1 Enabled
Fields.Description: If ON, colour slot 1 of the pattern can be recoloured.

Fields.Name: Slot 2 Enabled
Fields.Description: If ON, colour slot 2 of the pattern can be recoloured.

Fields.Name: Slot 3 Enabled
Fields.Description: If ON, colour slot 3 of the pattern can be recoloured.
